tasks.question: Design an autonomous research task where the agent receives a paper-level objective but no baseline code.
tasks.related_work_trap: Do not overclaim AIRS-Bench performance without running its official evaluator or using its task definitions.
tasks.toy_experiment: Convert one paper abstract into a constrained task spec and require a submission file plus evaluator stub.

tasks.question: Evaluate whether an agent can rediscover a known empirical insight without seeing the answer.
tasks.related_work_trap: Do not measure only paper fluency; require evidence that the rediscovered insight follows from experiments.
tasks.toy_experiment: Give a high-level research question and synthetic logs, then compare generated claims to a hidden target.

tasks.question: Test an agent on a data-driven discovery task where success requires analysis code and grounded interpretation.
tasks.related_work_trap: Do not treat a plausible narrative as a solved data-science task without executable analysis.
tasks.toy_experiment: Provide a small CSV with a hidden trend and require code, metrics, and a short interpretation.

tasks.question: Compare single-agent and multi-agent research workflows under matched inference budgets.
tasks.related_work_trap: Do not attribute gains to topology when the multi-agent workflow receives many more tokens or calls.
tasks.toy_experiment: Run direct, chain, and graph workflows with a fixed maximum API-call budget.

tasks.question: Measure whether a VLM figure-review gate catches unsupported visual claims before paper export.
tasks.related_work_trap: Do not claim VLM critique improves science unless it changes a decision or catches a real defect.
tasks.toy_experiment: Inject label and caption defects into generated plots and compare paper claims before and after VLM review.

tasks.question: Audit whether self-evolving strategy artifacts improve reliability without drifting into overclaiming.
tasks.related_work_trap: Do not equate any policy update with improvement; require before/after measurement and drift checks.
tasks.toy_experiment: Run two passes over shuffled tasks, update the strategy policy after pass one, and audit drift in pass two.
